tiles: Expressionist marks meet cyberpunk glow and glitch
High contrast palettes for charged emotion
challenge: Neo-expressionism thrives on raw gesture, high contrast, and emotional immediacy, while cyberpunk visual language adds industrial grit and luminous technological artifacts. Merging these two distinct aesthetic traditions into a cohesive portrait series required balancing visceral mark-making with controlled digital texture, ensuring each piece conveys charged emotion without descending into visual chaos.
approach: Used a generative pipeline to establish base forms and palette direction, then layered in neo-expressionist mark-making, glow discipline, and glitch texture through targeted in-painting. Each portrait balances raw gestural energy against controlled cyberpunk elements like luminous eyes, digital artifacts, and industrial surface treatments. The high-contrast color fields were carefully calibrated to heighten emotional tension while maintaining compositional coherence.
result: Produced a series of striking portraits that read viscerally in grid layouts and hold substantial depth at print scale. The collection successfully bridges two art-historical traditions through contemporary generative tools, demonstrating the ability to direct complex aesthetic intersections. The work is suited for editorial placement, gallery exhibition, and large-format print production.
